# Corrections and contributions

Use [Issues](https://github.com/ailinsun/MarketFlow/issues) for reproducible bugs, evidence-backed corrections or method questions. Include the file, release or commit, observation window, expected result and available evidence.

Use synthetic or aggregate examples. Do not post wallet lists, participant identities, credentials, private paths or contact details. Keep historical measurements intact; propose corrections with their source and explanation. Contract-pair labels remain provisional until independently reviewed.

For code changes, run `make check` and `make test` from the repository root before opening a pull request. Keep changes small and state which checks you ran. The offline instruments require only Python's standard library.
